instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show who answered a form, the score each earned and the segment each was sorted into, with a count per segment", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-form-results and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give a form_id to see one form, or nothing to see every form.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: segment-assignment (records:list).
